items.title: Agent Money Benchmark: Can AI Agents Be Trusted to Spend Money?
items.claim: Nine of twelve agents failed spending traps despite passing nearly all basic payment tasks.

items.title: A one-line momentum rule as the benchmark for intelligent intraday trading systems: evidence from NIFTY 50
items.claim: A simple momentum rule beats most learned intraday models at matched decision intervals and costs.

items.title: Are Calibrated Decision Models Calibrated on Markets? Geolocated News, Markov Switching and a System One Model for Nasdaq-100 Allocation
items.claim: Anchoring weekly market decline forecasts to the base rate fixes calibration and improves allocation returns.

items.title: Right Numbers, Wrong Story: When LLMs Narrate Financial Changes Beyond Their Inputs
items.claim: FrameCheck removes almost all unsupported framing from LLM financial drafts by rule without extra model calls.

items.title: Do Econophysics-Inspired Inputs Improve Neural Covariance Forecasting? A Leakage-Free Walk-Forward Study of Intraday DJIA Data
items.claim: Econophysics features add no measurable value to neural covariance forecasts beyond standard benchmarks after transaction costs.

items.title: FormaFin: Verifiable Financial Analysis with Solver-Guided Reinforcement Learning
items.claim: A 7B model formalizing loan rules outperforms open LLMs ten times larger and detects most financial analysis errors.
